Preregistration receipt — earworm-controlled-motif-robustness-v1

Frozen execution revision: `e5211d4dfd01fb06abbbc452fd55264b0a8bf1e8` (local isolated branch; included in final successor snapshot).
Protocol SHA256: `cfd190e65a4084ca094d98e720a09faaacda69641bbdf9732980d83870bc1391`.
Freeze manifest SHA256: `d0b1100afb110ba5a535bf8aaedd66f64f94c20de4385b13192783ceaf2d2ce7`.
Execution code SHA256: `5abd7bc3d75a459e34b2de3b242e2efb55b2d306bdde6f4ed360c8b9bfcaf87c`.
Frozen model SHA256: `786a775b7cb470685a4346c84908733130f21fd83973f3428de0a4febc862b27`.

Development and calibration each used 176 streams including future-substitution probes. No evaluation stimuli have been generated. Reserved evaluation: 24 fresh groups, 528 streams; total 880. The exact reference code/config remains unchanged. Selected candidate retains cutoff 0.1 and order 3; calibration selects smoothing only. Evaluation crosses both directions with both timbre families, including rich-demo/simple-cue combinations withheld from development/calibration. Proper scores use bins relative to the observed anchor, so octave mistakes are penalized. Supplied boundaries remain a limitation.

Frozen criteria and A/B/C/inconclusive branches are in `experiments/controlled-motif-robustness-v1/protocol.json`, `assignment.json`, and `analyze.py`; 5000 group resamples, seed 2026092007, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals for three cell contrasts. One evaluation, then one complete snapshot and stop for review. No follow-on run.
